text: Apparel and footwear items may be returned within 10 days of delivery when they are unused, unwashed, and returned with original tags.
The item must be packed with its original box or packaging where applicable.
Products marked as final sale or non-returnable on the listing are excluded.
Eligible electronics can be returned or replaced within 7 days of delivery when they are defective, damaged, or materially different from the listing.
Customers should keep the original accessories, invoice, and packaging for verification.
A technician visit may be arranged for selected large appliances before approval.
Eligible home and kitchen products may be returned within 10 days of delivery if they are unused and in saleable condition.
Assembly-related damage or missing parts should be reported with clear photos within the applicable return window.
Custom-made or hygiene-sensitive home items may be non-returnable when the listing says so.
Beauty and personal care items are returnable only when delivered damaged, defective, expired, or different from the order.
Opened, used, or seal-broken beauty products are not eligible for a change-of-mind return.
Customers should report a qualifying issue with photos as soon as possible after delivery.
For a successful cash-on-delivery return, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes the seller or warehouse quality check.
Refunds to the customer’s selected bank account or UPI ID generally appear within 5 to 7 business days after initiation.
The customer may track the refund status from the order details page.
Prepaid-order refunds are initiated after the returned item passes the required quality check or after a cancellation is confirmed.
The amount is sent back to the original payment method, and bank processing can take 3 to 7 business days.
Wallet refunds may appear sooner depending on the wallet provider.
Estimated delivery dates are shown on the product page and in the order details after an order is placed.
Standard delivery commonly takes 2 to 7 business days, while remote locations can require additional transit time.
Customers receive tracking updates when the shipment is packed, dispatched, and out for delivery.
Customers can update an address only before the order reaches the shipped stage, subject to serviceability checks.
Delivery partners normally make reasonable delivery attempts and may contact the customer for location assistance.
An undelivered shipment can be returned to the seller after unsuccessful attempts.
Reverse pickup is available when the return is eligible and the customer’s delivery pin code is serviceable for pickup.
The customer should hand over the correct item with included accessories and packaging at the scheduled pickup.
If pickup is unavailable, the order page provides an alternative self-ship option when supported.
A pickup partner scans or collects the package after a return request is approved.
Collection does not by itself guarantee a refund because the returned item can be checked for condition, serial number, accessories, and packaging.
A failed quality check may result in the item being sent back to the customer with an explanation.
Customers can request cancellation from the order details page before the order is packed or shipped.
Cancellation approval depends on the seller and fulfilment stage at the time of the request.
A prepaid cancellation refund follows the prepaid refund timeline after cancellation confirmation.
Customers should report a missing item, wrong item, or transit-damaged delivery from the order details page within the stated return or issue-reporting window.
Clear photos of the received item, package, and labels can speed up verification.
Eligible cases are resolved through replacement, return, or refund according to the product category policy.
